summary: First Eagle Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned financing subsidiary, First Eagle Private Credit Fund SPV, LLC, entered into a Fourth Amendment to its loan and servicing agreement on October 1, 2026. The amendment cuts the applicable margin to 2.25% during the revolving period and 2.75% during amortization, extends the commitment termination to October 1, 2027 and maturity to October 1, 2029, lowers the recurring revenue loan advance rate to 50.0%, reduces the unused fee to 0.50%, imposes a 1.0% prepayment premium before April 1, 2027, and tightens eligibility and lender protections. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch only for funding-cost and portfolio-composition effects, not deal arbitrage.
